findings.issue: The test paragraph still says six test cases own six criteria. AC7 and TC-08 make seven.
The paragraph says full tests are in v8 under the same ID, but the TC-P1-E2010-CON rows are not in v8, including new TC-07 and TC-08.
X2 still implies MSG-P4-001 or 002 covers no valid session, though section 14 says that message is not specified.
AC7 and TC-08 require a message ID for every error condition, but the no-valid-session message is not specified.
SCR-45 says 'empty' is not specified while listing 'breaks empty'. The item asks only for error and no access.
12.2 says the case base serves no treatment fact, contradicting the row above, which reads case treatments on that base.
The header records the workflow names but does not say they are the accepted target design choice.
The note says the story keeps MSG-P4-001 until a new ID exists, but omits that its meaning and text were realigned to the standard.
The note says the story is unchanged, but the 12.2 row was changed and split under GAP-2695.
